meta.title: Tadamsa n Qarṭaǧ — tagelda n ttjara
meta.desc: Iberdan n ttjara, lẓeɛfran, aqezdir d nnuqra n Hispanya, idrimen, tafellaḥt n Magun, lebḥura : amek i tuɣal Qarṭaǧ d yiwet seg timdinin tiɣelbanin akteṛ deg ddunit taqdimt.
hero.title: Tagelda n ttjara
hero.lede: Qarṭaǧ mačči d tezmert n umenɣi kan : ssɛaya-ines tekka-d seg uzeṭṭa n umsizwar i yeddan seg Tegzirin Tibritaniyin armi d ugmur n Tafrikt, akked seg ugaraw n Turuft armi d Ccerq.
hero.caption: Lebḥura ipuniyen : lebḥer azir n umenɣi (Cothon) akked lebḥer n ttjara
stats.0.t: n yimezdaɣ akken i d-yeqqar Strabon — imesnezruyen imaynuten ḥesben ugar 200 000 ɣer 400 000
stats.1.t: n lṭraten n nnuqra (≈ 100 kg) deg wass : lbir n Baebelo, i Hanibal (Pline)
stats.2.t: n tkalin i lbabura n umenɣi deg lebḥer azir (Appien)
stats.3.t: n yidlisen n wedlis n tfellaḥt n Magun
pillars.title: Tigejdal n tedamsa
pillars.aside: Ttjara, tiẓgi, lmɛadin akked lxiwanat : kuẓ n igumma n ssɛaya taqarṭaǧit.
pillars.items.0.d: Ul n tezmert taqarṭaǧit : iberdan n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan Lɣarbi.
pillars.items.0.items.0: Aḥraz n webrid agmaṛan n uqezdir
pillars.items.0.items.1: Aḥraz n yimagaren akked yiberdan tisertiyin
pillars.items.0.items.2: Lxiwanat seg Marok armi d Libya, di Sicile, Sardaigne, Jzayer Baléares, Hispanya
pillars.items.0.items.3: Amsizwar akked Igrikiyen, Yitruskiyen akked timdinin tifiniqiyin
pillars.items.1.d: Tiẓgi tazegzawt n Tunisia n wassa gent Qarṭaǧ d axxam n yirden n Lebḥer Ageraɣlan.

pillars.items.2.items.1: Ddheb d ṣṣfeṛ n tegzirt n Hispanya
pillars.items.2.items.2: Aqezdir n « Tegzirin n Cassitérides », ɣer ugafa-agmur

routes.title: Iberdan n ttjara
routes.rows.1.imp: Lebxur, tiɣawsiwin n lemtaɛ, aɣes n ulfil
routes.rows.2.exp: Lmelḥ, ssǧaǧed, lfexxaṛ, tikuraf n djaǧ
routes.rows.2.imp: Ddheb, aɣes n ulfil, lḥiwanat ibeṛṛaniyen
routes.note: Lxiwanat i yemmten s wezɣal (ssǧaǧed, aɣanim, lmakla) ǧǧan-d drus n lɛalamat : tibdarin-agi smiden iḏrisen iqdimen d tesnfarrut.
map.title: Tirzan
map.aside: Elisa seg Ṣur ɣer Qarṭaǧ, Hanun ɣef rrif n Tafrikt, Himilcon ɣer Ugaraw n Turuft n ugafa : ḍfeṛ iberdan, syen timura.
map.cards.0.d: Settin n lbabura ɣef rrif n ugaraw n Turuft n Tafrikt, iwakken ad yesres lxiwanat, akken i d-yeqqar Tiklarit yettwaseknen fell-as.
map.cards.1.t: Gadir, tawwurt n Ugaraw n Turuft
map.cards.1.d: Tamdint tafiniqit tamddakelt n Qarṭaǧ : syen i yeddu Himilcon ɣer ugafa, ɣef webrid n uqezdir.
map.cards.2.d: Deffir n Tgejdal n Hercule, Iqarṭaǧiyen sersen lxiwanat-nsen ɣef uglaḍ, imbeɛd rewlen ; imezdaɣ sersen-d ddheb ɣer tama. Ttɛawaden armi d lqerra, war ma mmeslayen — war lexdeɛ, akken i d-yeqqar Hérodote.
purple.title: Lẓeɛfran akked lxiwanat
purple.paras.0: Yettwawrit seg Ṣur, aẓeɛfran yețwakseb seg murex, ṣṣedfa n lebḥer anida ilaq agar n tezgalin i kra n igramen n uẓeɛfran. Di Kerkouane, ɣef Ras Addar, igar n ṣṣedfa yettwarẓen sbeggnen-d lxiwanat ; tigzirt n Djerba teqqim-d tesεeddi deg zzman aṛumani.
purple.paras.1: Lxiwanat n Qarṭaǧ xeddment daɣen lfexxaṛ, tikuraf d ucenfiṛen n djaǧ, lǥawahar, leslaḥ akked ssǧaǧed. Lcantyat n lbabura bennun s wawal : yal aqeṭṭuɛ yesɛa asekkil n usemday.
ports.title: Sin lebḥura deg yiwen
ports.rows.0.v: Agelmim uslig i lbabura n ttjara, yeldi ɣer lebḥer.
ports.rows.1.v: Deffir-s, Cothon azir : 220 n tkalin i lbabura n umenɣi, ur ttwalin ara seg ugaraw.
ports.rows.2.v: Deg wammas, axxam n unemhal, sɣur-s ițɛesses lebḥer.
ports.rows.3.v: Yiwet kan n tewwurt, azal n 21 m (70 n iḍaren), yettwamdalen s snasel n uzzal (Appien).
metals.title: Lmɛadin n ugmur
metals.aside: War aqezdir, war azzal n ṣṣfeṛ. War nnuqra, war iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen. Qarṭaǧ teṭṭef iberdan n yiwen, lmɛadin n wayeḍ.
metals.items.0.d: Ilaq bessif i uzzal n ṣṣfeṛ, yekka-d seg ugafa-agmur n Turuft — « Tegzirin n Cassitérides », Cornouailles, Bretagne neɣ Galice. Himilcon yesnirem abrid-agi agmaṛan ; Qarṭaǧ teḥrez ssir-ines s telqey.
metals.items.1.d: Mbeɛd 237, At Barka xeddmen lmɛadin n unzul n Hispanya. Akken i d-yeqqar Pline, lbir n Baebelo kan yefka i Hanibal 300 n lṭraten n nnuqra deg wass. Lqern mbeɛd, Polybe yeḥseb 40 000 n yixeddamen ɣef rrif n Carthagène.
metals.items.2.d: Ddheb n Tafrikt s umsizwar agmaṛan d uneggaru n Ssaḥra, ddheb d ṣṣfeṛ n Hispanya : azal i gezmeɣ idrimen i uxleṣ n lɛesker n iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen deg umenɣi mgal Ṛuma.
trade.title: Asɣaṛ, azenz, tirza
trade.aside: Am Ṣur send-as, Qarṭaǧ tedder s ttjara n lmɛadin akked ṣṣufa.
trade.quoteD: Iwerriten n Ifiniqiyen, Iqarṭaǧiyen țwaḥesben deg ddunit taqdimt d imeskaren n lebḥer d imsizwar war amsaɛdal.
trade.quoteSrc: Pline, Amezruy n tɣawsiwin, VII — yettwabder sɣur F. Decret (1977)
trade.rows.0.v: Ɣer unzul n Hispanya, nnuqra, ṣṣfeṛ akked uqezdir llan deg lmɛadin yeshel ad ten-id-tessiwed, ad ten-txeddem : laṣel n ssɛaya tafiniqit, imbeɛd taqarṭaǧit.
trade.rows.1.v: Qarṭaǧ tettaɛraḏ tettfeṛṛeq tiɣawsiwin timeẓyanin : lfexxaṛ agrikan d uyitrusk, ticenfiṛin d tɣawsiwin timiṣriyin.
trade.rows.2.v: Ifiniqo-ipuniyen ṭṭfen qrib akk tanejma n lebḥer deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan Lɣarbi : asɣaṛ ilelli n lmɛadin, lexṛuǧat ɣer Ccerq, akked igrudan n tmura meṛṛa.
trade.rows.3.v: Ɣer Alalia, di Corse, Iqarṭaǧiyen akked Yitruskiyen nnuɣen akked Iphocéens, i yeǧǧan tigzirt mbeɛd (Hérodote, I, 166).
trade.rows.4.v: Sin lemɛahda akked Ṛuma fraqen lebḥura : Iṛumaniyen ur aɛḏun ara « Ucenfiṛ Ihlan » akked, di Tafrikt am Sardaigne, ur sɣaṛen ara war lḥuḍur n umḥekkem (Polybe, III, 22-24).
trade.blocks.0.d: Uqbel kra n ifecka ibernanen — nnuqra, ṣṣfeṛ, aqezdir n Hispanya d Tegzirin n Cassitérides —, imbeɛd tiɣawsiwin : lekwas igrikiyen d wiyitrusk, i yeḥerz usinag n Bardo deg tiɣawsiwin-is, akked ticenfiṛin timiṣriyin.
trade.blocks.1.d: Djaǧ, lmesnuɛt tafiniqit, lǥawahar, lfexxaṛ, ssǧaǧed yețwaẓeɛfṛen, tiɣawsiwin n uɣes n ulfil, n ddheb neɣ n nnuqra. Ssǧaǧed, ɣas akken ițwassnen aṭas, qrib ruḥen akk : kan igar n murex d yimidalen n leqdic n ssejjada i yeqqimen-d.
trade.blocks.2.d: Asɣaṛ yeḍfeṛ daɣen iberdan n tikerraven, iweɛren ugar, i d-yesseḍhaṛen tanazduɣin di Libya akked unzul n Tunisia. Tirzan n tsenfarrut qesdent lemqasad-nniḍen : lmɛadin — aqezdir, ddheb n Lmaɣrib — akked tiwwura timaynutin n usɣaṛ.
sea.title: Lebḥer yesseččen
sea.aside: Aṣid, aqqes akked lqut n uslem : lesnaɛa i d-tettaɛ Ṛuma s lmeqyas ameqqran.
sea.items.0.d: Lqut n uslem yesεan dhen, yettwaseqdac deg uṭṭbib akked deg wučči. D Ifiniqo-ipuniyen i d-isnejmaεen aseqdec-ines deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan ; xeddmen-t s lmeqyas ameqqran deg yimukan i yettwafen di waṭas n yimukan (Krings akked Lipinski).
sea.items.1.d: Aslem iqqesen, yettwačaṭ deg ikufan, yettedda akked lmesnuɛat-nniḍen n lebḥer deg Lebḥer Ageraɣlan akk.
sea.items.2.d: Idrimen n Gadès, Cadix n wassa, ɣefsen aṣaweḏ : asekken n tazmert n uṣid-agi deg tedamsa n temdint tafiniqit.
sea.items.3.d: Yettwaṣid ɣef uẓeɛfran, yettwaǧmeε deg igar n ṣṣedfa yettwarẓen qrib lxiwanat n uẓeɛfran.
sea.note: Aheggi akked ttjara n garum kemmlen s telqey ddaw n Ṛuma : lxiwanat n uqqes ḥerzen akteṛ, am tin n Baelo Claudia qrib Cadix, d tiqdimin seg zzman aṛumani.
coins.title: Idrimen akked yiḏrisen
coins.aside: Qarṭaǧ tegra idrimen ɣur-s, maca s lmeqyas ameqqran, s telqey i uxleṣ n lɛesker-is.
coins.qAlt: Ṛebɛ n ssekel n At Barka
coins.qD: Ṛebɛ n ssekel yettwagen di Hispanya sɣur At Barka, lqern wis 3 send Ɛisa.
coins.eD: Ssekel n nnuqra : aqerru n Melqart akked ulfil n umenɣi (British Museum).
coins.rows.0.v: Idrimen ipuniyen imezwura, s nnuqra, yettwagen di Sicile i uxleṣ n lɛesker ; kra ssekknen-d « lferrik ».
coins.rows.1.v: Qarṭaǧ s yiman-is tegg ddheb d ṣṣfeṛ. Lemtul : aqerru n Tanit, aɣyul, tazdayt — tazdayt (phoinix s tegrikit) tessawal-d ɣer Ifiniqiyen.
coins.rows.2.v: Deg wussan n yimenɣan mgal Ṛuma, idrimen n électrum (asemdiweg n ddheb d nnuqra) akked idrimen s lqima yessemẓiyen : idrimen n temdint ḥeznen.
coins.rows.3.v: Di Hispanya, At Barka ggen ssekel n nnuqra yelhan aṭas, s Melqart, ulfil neɣ tagejdit n lbabur.
coins.fiscD: Qarṭaǧ tedder s ṣṣerf n ttjara, s lxerj n timura ițwaḥuddun — ifellaḥen ilibikiyen ttuḥettmen ad fken armi d uzgen n lmeḥṣul-nsen deg umenɣi apunik amezwaru (Polybe) —, s lmɛadin n Hispanya akked lxerj n tfellaḥt. Annect-agi akk i uxleṣ n lɛesker n yiɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen war ma tessawel akk i yimezdaɣ-is.
agri.caption: Tazemmurt qrib Testour, deg wasif n Medjerda
agri.title: Tafellaḥt yesɛan tamusni
agri.intro: Ameǥeri aqarṭaǧi Magun yura adlis n tfellaḥt deg 28 n yidlisen. Mbeɛd aɣelli n Qarṭaǧ, Ssenaṭ aṛumani yefka lameṛ s tsuɣelt-is ɣer tlatinit — ccan ur yettwafken i ula d yiwen adlis-nniḍen apunik.
agri.facts.0.d: 28 n yidlisen ɣef wakal, tfeṛṛant, uzemmur, afennu akked tedbelt n lexlawat, yettwabder sɣur Varron, Columelle d Pline.
agri.facts.1.d: Qarṭaǧ txeddem tezenz s lmeqyas ameqqran zzit-is, tamɛadalt n lmesnuɛat tigrikiyin.
agri.facts.2.d: Ccṛab iqarṭaǧiyen ɛemmer ițwassnen, s telqey passum, ccṛab n uẓalim yeqqur i d-yeḥrez Columelle talɣa-ines seg Magun.
agri.facts.3.d: Lǥab, laberat akked taɛawant n waman iwakken ad tettwaxdem tmurt iwεren.
agri.domAlt: Takatut n Siyyid Julius, asinag n Bardo
agri.domK: Asinag n Bardo · lqern wis 4 mbeɛd Ɛisa
agri.domD: Takatut-agi n zzman aṛumani tesken-d taɛzibt tameqqrant n tama n Qarṭaǧ s imuren akk : zzitun, aẓalim, lḥiwanat n lǧer. Lexlawat tifellaḥt timeqqranin i d-yeqqimen seg zzman apunik gan Tafrikt d axxam n yirden n Ṛuma.
